content:
\(4040=2^3\cdot 5\cdot 101\). For \(n\) consecutive naturals starting at \(a\),

\[
n(2a+n-1)=4040.
\]

So \(n\mid 4040\), and

\[
a=\frac{\frac{4040}{n}-n+1}{2}.
\]

Testing divisors of \(4040\) from largest down, the first valid value is \(n=40\):

\[
2a=\frac{4040}{40}-40+1=101-40+1=62,
\]

so \(a=31\). Thus

\[
2020=31+32+\cdots+70.
\]

\[
\boxed{2020=31+32+\cdots+70\ (40\text{ consecutive natural numbers})}
\]
